title: Juicy Smoky French Beetroot Gratin
description: A savory French dish featuring cooked beetroot, smoke, and crunchy texture, perfect for a kid-friendly dinner. This ovo-vegetarian friendly gratin is a delicious and healthy meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced beetroot with smoked paprika, garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion until it is softened and translucent.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of sauteed onion.
Add a layer of beetroot slices on top of the onion layer.
Sprinkle a third of the shredded gruyere cheese and a third of the bread crumbs over the beetroot layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese and bread crumbs on top.
Drizzle the beaten eggs over the top layer of cheese and bread crumbs.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the beetroot is tender.
